info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Certificates API enables organizations to retrieve information about certificates associated with student enrollments in educational programs. This endpoint allows educational institutions and administrators to access detailed records of issued certificates, improving visibility into student achievements. Developers and data analysts can utilize this API to create dashboards or reports that provide insights into enrollment outcomes. It serves as an essential resource for managing and showcasing educational credentials.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the enrollment certificates associated with their account. The request will return relevant certificate details necessary for verification or record-keeping.
